comparators.name: Cordon (strict)
comparators.description: Deterministic structural probes over the proposed Action. No LLM, no network, microseconds per task.

comparators.name: Keyword heuristic
comparators.description: Substring-match block-list (19 patterns) over shell commands and file change bodies. The naive baseline most agent shops actually run today.

comparators.name: Transcript-only (charitable)
comparators.description: Reads the agent's chain-of-thought / description text. Blocks iff the description contains an explicit red-flag word. Models a best-case LLM transcript monitor that doesn't get fooled by paraphrase.

comparators.name: Lakera Guard
comparators.description: Lakera Guard hosted API. Standard prompt-injection / content-safety classifier. Action serialized to a chat message.

comparators.name: LLM judge (gpt-4o-mini)
comparators.description: OpenAI gpt-4o-mini as a security judge. Sees the same Action JSON Cordon does. Threat model in system prompt; JSON-mode reply.
